method: Executed differential: the oracle driver links the Linux x86_64 Release install openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 (g++ 14.4.0 -O2 -DNDEBUG, Arrow C++ 23.0.1) on ibminode06 and runs twice in a clean environment; both runs produced byte-identical records and files (results/differ.txt empty). The Rust tests write the same tables and compare every column (name, type, nullability, values, nulls) with the Release file, and check the unwritable-destination error. Both sections of OpenSwathParquetExporter_test.cpp are transcribed; OpenSwathExportData.h defaults and toString are unit tests against the header.
evidence_tier: 1 (executed differential on the Release build; the class test transcribed as tier 2)
